title: Another aerospace company leaves the work in the early 1970s

tellings.quote: my recollection from the senior vice president of the other company is that they kind of uh left that whole line of work

plain: A second aerospace company that had been working on reverse engineering, meaning taking apart recovered craft of non-human origin to learn how they work, gave up that work in the early 1970s after being involved from around 1960. The physicist Eric W. Davis tells Michels this is his recollection of what a senior vice president of that company told him, that they 'kind of left that whole line of work'. He does not name the company or the executive.
